race.title: Ryans Cleaning Handicap Chase
race.verdict: PREDATORS GOLD likely would have won a Grade 1 novice last season but for a late mishap and, with Paul Townend keeping the faith, is taken to make a successful handicap debut. Letos is feared most despite being out of the weights given how well treated he looks on last season's hurdles form, while Argento Boy may need a stiffer test but appeals for minor honours. PREDATORS GOLD (FR) LETOS (FR) ARGENTO BOY (IRE)
